Name: Joles' Colorful Chickens
Author: JolieBeau
Description:
This mod lets you replace the default white and brown chickens with some more colorful options. It's a recolor that will edit all your white and / or all your brown chickens with the baby chicks including. I highly recommend you use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098http://]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ with this mod even though it's not required, it's just way more fun to use the drop-down and play around in game.

After starting the game for the first time, the config.json gets created. If you don't want to use Generic Mod Config Menu for some reason, you can edit this file yourself. Make sure to only enter the color and not the full asset name. Example: 

[code] ﻿{
﻿  ﻿"BrownColor": "RosyBrown",
﻿ ﻿ "WhiteColor": "Moss"
﻿}[/code]﻿
